source.name: Data.NOLA.gov Calls for Service 2024
source.where: timecreate between "2024-01-01T00:00:00" and "2025-01-01T00:00:00" AND location.latitude between 29.866661 and 30.198660 AND location.longitude between -90.140074 and -89.625053

worker_judgment_notes: Selected the official Data.NOLA.gov/NOPD Calls for Service 2024 Socrata feed because it exposes a stable call identifier (nopd_item), event date (timecreate), offense signal code/text (type_/typetext), and Socrata point coordinates via location.latitude/location.longitude. The 2024 Electronic Police Report feed was checked and has richer charge/report fields but no point geometry, so it is not suitable for generic city-share onboarding. This is a share-lane-only contract: CFS records are CAD/preliminary incident events, can be reclassified, and must not be promoted as annual offense totals. The where clause removes zero/redacted/out-of-city coordinates before download, and the runner still spatially joins to the municipal block groups. Rape is intentionally omitted because the official CFS metadata says sex-offense coordinates are removed/redacted, and the observed rape signal rows resolve to 0/0 rather than usable city points. Aggravated assault is limited to aggravated battery/aggravated assault/assault-with-weapon and attempted murder signal codes; simple assault, simple battery, accidental shooting, generic shooting/stabbing, weapons possession, alarms, vehicle burglary, fraud, embezzlement, identity theft, recovery-only vehicle events, unauthorized use, and property-only noise are excluded. Burglary excludes vehicle burglary and alarm-only categories. Larceny excludes fraud/embezzlement/identity-theft categories. New Orleans jurisdiction_id and state_fips came from state/controls/jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet; bounds came from the repo block_group_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk joined to Louisiana 2020 TIGER block groups for jurisdiction 22:municipal:place:2255000.
